newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Samitri maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Samitri maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc said it has maintained its buy rating and earnings forecast for shares of Samitri iron mining company.

-- "Our recommendation reflects the strong growth potential for earnings following production increases, and the relatively low valuation in relation to projected cash flow and earnings," the brokerage said in a report.

-- Fleming said Samitri's third-quarter net profit of 3.3 million reais or 0.35 reais a share was down 34 percent from the second quarter due to inventory build-up at its Samarco unit and higher-than-expected finance costs at Samitri.
-- But it said it expects strong fourth-quarter results from both Samitri and its 51-percent-owned Samarco.

-- "Production at Samitri's mines should be higher with new capacity coming on stream (and) Samarco is expected to boost sales as it is disposes of inventory accumulated in the third quarter," Fleming said. The brokerage estimates Samitri will post an 18 million-real net profit in 1996 and a 42 million real net profit in 1997.
-- Samitri preferred rose 0.30 reais to 29.30 reais while its voting common was off 4.50 reais at 30.00 reais at 1608 local/1808 GMT on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
